critiques.assumption: An outlined carrier can support both workshop completeness checking and customer arrangement guidance under the incumbent assembled handoff.
critiques.limitation: The supplied incumbent is packed assembled. A1 does not specify how a customer reads the carrier after parts leave its outlined positions. A reusable staging aid and a shipped carrier also have different cost and bench implications. No supplied observation establishes that either is feasible.
critiques.opening: Separate the reusable physical checking surface from its portable arrangement key, preserving an explicit correspondence between them.
critiques.comparison: Z1 supplies counted staging; Z2 supplies a customer drawing; A1 couples both on one carrier. A reusable mat plus matching annotated order slip could retain their interaction without requiring a carrier in every shipment. The shared mapping can also propagate one error through both checks.
critiques.probe: Compare coupled and independently prepared staging/drawing combinations, counting all preparation and transfer labor. Independently verify the mapping against an actual assembled sample before using it.

openings.claim: A reusable order-specific staging mat paired with a matching arrangement key on the existing slip may connect workshop component verification to customer reconstruction while retaining preassembly.
openings.delta: Keep A1's outlined positions at the bench; transfer only the arrangement key to the slip. Include selected exterior color and a distinct short-partition cue.
openings.prediction: Relative to Z1 alone, the key should improve reconstruction; relative to Z2 alone, the mat should expose omissions. Relative to A1, reuse may lower recurring material cost, but copying labor may erase time savings. Incorrect mappings or indistinguishable incompatible parts defeat both channels.
openings.probe: First manually verify one layout's mapping using existing templates and a sample; automatic mapping remains unsupported. Screen incumbent, mat-only, key-only and coupled versions within 15 samples, including seeded errors. Use ten participants for exploratory reconstruction trials; confirm thresholds in the 60-unit pilot only if costs and schedule permit.
assumptions: Footprint, capacity, reversible partitions, ordered counts and colors remain unchanged.
Initial cost stays at most 500, added recurring materials at most 0.40 per order, and delivery remains fixed.
Single-bench occupancy and annotation labor are included in timing; all probes remain proposed.
